performance.scope: Same-input native call A/B, including mandatory full tape reset; startup/import/verification/lowering excluded. Each observation is mean of 16 timed calls; three fresh orchestrator/transport runs, ten randomized pairs per case/run, three warmup calls per arm/case/run. No overhead subtraction.
